Reviewed for the public Job Board API only (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token> and /jobs; SPEC_151). Greenhouse Job Board API docs (https://developers.greenhouse.io/job-board.html, redirects to docs.greenhouse.io): 'Job Board data is publicly available, so authentication is not required for any GET endpoints.' No rate limit or use restriction stated. Greenhouse legal center (https://www.greenhouse.com/legal) lists the Master Subscription Agreement, DPA, privacy and cookie notices -- customer documents; no website terms with a clause on automated access, robots, scraping or data mining. robots.txt (boards-api.greenhouse.io, 2026-10-02): 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /embed/' and still applies.

Reviewed for the public Postings API only (api.lever.co/v0/postings/<site>?mode=json; SPEC_151). lever/postings-api README (https://github.com/lever/postings-api): 'This API is designed to help you create a job site'; only application POSTs are rate limited. Lever Terms of Service, last updated August 25, 2023 (https://www.lever.co/legal/terms-of-service, the footer 'Terms of Use' link): they 'govern a customer's acquisition and use of Lever ... software and/or services'; their bar on access 'for any other benchmarking or competitive purposes' concerns Lever's software, not employers' published postings. robots.txt (api.lever.co, 2026-10-02): 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Crawl-delay: 1' and still applies.

Terms reviewed for the public job posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<org>?includeCompensation=true; SPEC_151). Ashby Customer Terms of Service, last updated September 29, 2025 (https://www.ashbyhq.com/terms): effective when a Customer 'first completes a purchase ... or logs into the Service' -- customers only; no clause on automated access or scraping. developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/public-job-posting-api documents the endpoint with no use restriction. NOTE: api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers 401 Unauthorized to every user agent (2026-10-02); open_web treats 401 as disallow-all, so the gate refuses the API and nothing is fetched until that changes or the owner decides otherwise.

GLEIF LEI data terms of use (https://www.gleif.org/en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use, fetched 2026-10-03): 'The Access Service on the website http(s)://www.gleif.org is provided for free. The data available through the Access Service are provided under the CC0 licence'. SPEC_154 uses api.gleif.org only (robots.txt: 'User-agent: * / Disallow:'); goldencopy.gleif.org/robots.txt answers 403, which the gate reads as disallow-all, so the Golden Copy zips are not fetched. GLEIF's API allows 60 requests per minute; the connector paces at >= 2 s.

S&P Global DUNL: the site footer names CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 ('By using this site, you confirm your acceptance of the terms of this license'), the company dataset metadata names CC BY-SA 4.0 and the 2025-09-11 press release limits use to 'free internal organizational use'. Conflicting non-commercial / share-alike terms: no request until S&P confirms commercial use in writing (SPEC_154, reviewed 2026-10-03). The existing dunl reference-data client does not use this gate.

Covers api.datamgmt.spglobal.com (the keyless DUNL paging / resolve API) and www.spglobal.com: same conflicting DUNL licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 site, CC BY-SA 4.0 metadata, 'internal organizational use'), and the S&P Terms of Use (https://www.spglobal.com/en/terms-of-use) returned an error page on 2026-10-03, so no clause on automated access could be read (SPEC_154).
